cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I wasn't just late to the reunion. Can I tell you? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I saved you a seat beside me. Was it the traffic?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. No. I waited outside for half an hour. Can you hear why?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm here. But I thought you didn't want to sit with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wanted that seat. I was afraid you'd be happier without me there. Will you sit beside me now?

mechanism: A organizes clearing up a reunion absence, adapting to B hurt before admitting a deeper fear and asking B to remain beside A.
confusable: Unlike seeking reassurance without disclosure, A progressively reveals the avoided truth; authority depends on B agreeing to hear more.
comparison: A friend at a reunion wants a place beside B, unlike partners facing doubt about their relationship.
seedUse: D107-b saved seat and waiting outside; S02-b altered approach to keep the partner participating.
